data.gender_notes: Charuvrat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Charuvrat is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Charu' which means desirable or lovable and 'Vrat' which means chariot. This name suggests a person who is desirable or lovable, just like a chariot that is loved and cherished. It is a powerful and evocative name that is sure to leave a lasting impression. The name Charuvrat carries the meaning “Desirable or Lovable Chariot” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Charuvrat usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable or lovable chariot and live with faith, good character and purpose.
